newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Samancor splits top management roles.
newsitem.headline: Samancor splits top management roles.

text.p: South African mining group Samancor said on Monday that it is splitting its top management roles of executive chairman and managing director.

Current executive chairman Mike Salamon said in a statement that the general manager of the firm's chrome division, Wilrich Schroeder, will take up the new separate role of managing director from December 1, 1996.
The firm said in a brief statement that it would make an announcement on a new head of the chrome division in the near future.
Samancor produces manganese, chromium, silicon, dolomite and other products.
